_comment: PROPOSED Toast <-> MarginEdge mappings for management/chef review. Load with `node scripts/admin/load-marginedge-mappings.mjs` (dry run) then `--apply`. EVERY row is reviewStatus 'proposed' and produces NO cost until a human changes it to 'confirmed' — see docs/MARGINEDGE_COST_AUDIT.md §8 and §11. Product ids and prices were read live from the MarginEdge public API (GET only) on 2026-09-01: /products for latestPrice + reportByUnit, /vendors/{id}/vendorItems and /packaging for size grades and pack sizes, and every invoice line 2026-08-01..2026-09-01 for what was actually bought. `resolution` says how much of the portion MarginEdge itself pins down: derivable_from_marginedge = price AND portion follow from MarginEdge + the Toast item name (a manager can confirm without weighing anything); needs_manager_confirmation = one yes/no about SKU identity or plating policy; needs_purchasing_count = one count off a received case or packing slip; needs_chef_portion = only the kitchen knows the plated weight/count. Quantities marked ASSUMED are placeholders so the reviewer only has to correct a number.

mappings.portionBasis: 2 clusters x 9 oz ASSUMED = 1.125 lb. MarginEdge pins the grade, not the average: every August purchase is '8/Up' (US Foods 'Crab Snow Clstr 8+ Z In Shl' 30 lb cases, Samuels 'Snow Crab Clusters 8/Up'), i.e. each cluster weighs AT LEAST 8 oz, so the floor is 1.0 lb; 8/up product commercially runs 8-10 oz and 9 oz is the midpoint.
mappings.residualQuestion: Count the clusters in one 30 lb US Foods case at receiving: average oz per cluster = 480 / count. If it comes back 48-60 the 9 oz default stands.
mappings.notes: Highest-volume AYCE item (1,184 units over 34 days). $11.50/lb is the Samuels price (17% of Aug pounds, most recent invoice); US Foods supplied 82% at $335 per 30 lb = $11.17/lb, so the volume-weighted Aug price is $11.23/lb. At 9 oz: $12.94 (latest) / $12.63 (blended) vs ACE rough $14.50. Previous seed value 1.261 lb was back-solved from ACE's rough cost and is superseded.

mappings.portionBasis: 1 cluster x 9 oz ASSUMED = 0.5625 lb (floor 0.5 lb from the 8/Up grade). Must stay exactly half of the 2-cluster row.
mappings.residualQuestion: Same case count as the 2-cluster row.
mappings.notes: At 9 oz: $6.47 (latest $11.50/lb) / $6.31 (Aug blended) vs ACE rough $7.50.

mappings.portionBasis: 1 whole cold-water tail of the 6/7 oz grade = 6.5 oz midpoint = 0.40625 lb. Every August purchase under this product is the 6-7 oz grade (Samuels 'Lobster Tail 6/7 Spring Cold Water' 210 lb @ $25.00/lb; Capital Seaboard 'Lobster Tails cw 6-7oz' $239 per 10 lb case = $23.90/lb; J.J. McDonnell 'Lobster Cw/Tail 6-7OZ' $24.90/lb), matching the Toast item name.
mappings.residualQuestion: Optional: tails per 10 lb case as received (160 oz / N gives the exact average instead of the 6.5 oz midpoint; +/-8%).
mappings.notes: $10.16 at latest $25.00/lb ($10.01 at the Aug weighted $24.65/lb; band $9.24-$10.94). ACE's $12.00 is 18% high. The product is priced per POUND, not per tail. 400 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 3 prawns ASSUMED at 7 per lb (every August line is 'King Prawn Head On 6/8' = 6-8 per lb; 11 lb cases; the kitchen specs this SKU by count: 'Must Be 6-8!'). The a-la-carte sibling 'AUSSIE KING PRAWNS (1/2 lb)' = 3-4 prawns; the AYCE item carries no portion in its name, so 1/2 lb is a ceiling, not a fact.
mappings.residualQuestion: How many prawns are plated on one AYCE 'AUS KING PRAWNS' order (2, 3 or 4)? And is the $44 a-la-carte 1/2 lb plated as a fixed count?
mappings.notes: Per prawn $2.56 at $17.89/lb (range $2.24-$2.98). 3 prawns = $7.67, 4 = $10.22, 1/2 lb = $8.95; ACE rough $12.00 = 6 prawns at the old $13.99 price. Price rose $13.99 -> $17.89 (+28%) in late August; MarginEdge product is misnamed 'U/6' (nothing bought is U/6) and an orphan 'Shrimp, 6/8' product #1266217520 holds the stale $13.99 — never map to it. 455 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1 lb — published by the restaurant itself: chasintailsss.com/menu lists 'LOUISIANA CRAWFISH – Eunice, 1 pound' and the Postmates listing reads 'Louisiana, 1 pound'. MarginEdge supplies only the price ($4.95/lb); the Toast name carries no weight.
mappings.residualQuestion: Optional: is the pound weighed frozen straight from the 5 lb bag (exactly 5 orders per bag) or after thawing (then a glaze/drip loss % applies)?
mappings.notes: $4.95/lb, identical on all 23 August invoices (1,440 lb, every line = qty x 4.95). 1 lb = $4.95 vs ACE rough $5.50. DATA QUALITY: every purchase is J.J. McDonnell CRA419 'Crawfish Fz Whl Ckd 5# BG' (frozen whole cooked) but it is homed under the product named 'Crawfish, Live' while 'Crawfish, Whole Cooked' #830103200 ($4.89, stale, no purchases) sits empty — remap/merge on the MarginEdge side. 453 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1 lb as named. 26 August invoices, all Samuels 'Shrimp 21/25 Quick Peels Easy To Peel 20Lb Case', 1,460 lb at $5.45/lb, no other SKU bought.
mappings.residualQuestion: none (manager may confirm the EZ-peel bag is filled from the Quick Peel case, not the Tropic shell-on case)
mappings.notes: $5.45 vs ACE rough $4.85 (+12%). 255 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1/2 lb as named. Same product and price as the 1 lb row.
mappings.residualQuestion: none
mappings.notes: $2.725 vs ACE's $2.50 portion override. Once confirmed the MarginEdge cost outranks the override. 371 units observed.

mappings.residualQuestion: Confirm the JUMBO WHITE bag is filled from the Tropic 21/25 shell-on case ($4.50) and EZ PEEL from the Quick Peel case ($5.45), not the reverse.
mappings.notes: $4.50 vs ACE rough $4.85. 71 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1/2 lb as named. Same product as the 1 lb row.
mappings.residualQuestion: none
mappings.notes: $2.25 vs ACE's $2.50 portion override. 145 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1 lb as named. Every August purchase under this product is Capital Seaboard '30/40 Cnt Head-On Shrimp 40#' at $158-162 per 40 lb case = $3.95-4.05/lb (30/40 per kg head-on is the same shrimp as 16/20 headless per lb). The other head-on products (9/12 at $4.19, U/7 at $10.95) had no August purchases.
mappings.residualQuestion: none (thin volume: 5 cases in August, so one substituted case moves the price)
mappings.notes: $3.95 vs ACE rough $4.85. 24 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1/2 lb as named. Same product as the 1 lb row.
mappings.residualQuestion: none
mappings.notes: $1.975 vs ACE's $2.50 portion override. 32 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 0.16 lb (2.56 oz) of mix ASSUMED, back-solved from ACE's $4.00 portion override at $25.00/lb. The mix (Aunt Connie's, Samuels, 5 lb tubs at $125 = $25.00/lb, 18 August lines) is bought by weight; nothing in MarginEdge states the cake size. Corroboration: August purchases (140-196 lb of mix incl. a raw-lump substitute) against ~33 cakes/day sold across all crab-cake items imply an all-cakes average of 2.2-3.1 oz raw, so a 4 oz AYCE cake is essentially impossible.
mappings.residualQuestion: How many AYCE-size cakes come out of one 5 lb tub of AC mix (or which scoop), and is the $39 two-piece entree cake the same size?
mappings.notes: 696 units observed. $4.00 at $25.00/lb (bracket $3.42-$4.80 over the usage range; $3.84 at the Aug weighted $24.00/lb). DATA QUALITY: one 2026-08-22 line at $85 per unit ('Baynes Sound B.C. Ac Crab Cake Mix' — OCR merge with an oyster line, or the cheaper claw mix) would set latestPrice to $17.00/lb if processed last; and Samuels substituted 36 lb of raw lump crabmeat for the mix on 08-16/08-23, booked under 'Crabmeat, Lump' #828264156 — never map to that product (it also carries the mis-coded mussels line).

mappings.portionBasis: 0.139 lb (2.2 oz) ASSUMED, back-solved from ACE's rough $2.50 at the old $17.99/lb. Fillets are bought whole (4.1-4.6 lb each, catch weight) so the portion should be stated as orders per fillet or as trimmed oz per plate plus a trim yield.
mappings.residualQuestion: How many crudo orders come out of one ~4.3 lb hamachi fillet (or trimmed oz per plate + yield)?
mappings.notes: Price moved $15.99 -> $20.95/lb in late August as the SKU changed to frozen 'Mandarin Orange feed' fillets (Aug weighted $18.12/lb); purchasing should confirm which is the standing order. 3 oz served at ~70% trim yield = $5.61 at $20.95. 311 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 0.24 lb ASSUMED, back-solved from ACE's explicit $3.00 at $12.49/lb. Bought as 12 x 1 lb retail packs of tail meat ($12.49/lb, stable, 13 August lines); the 1 lb pack is a prep unit, not a plate.
mappings.residualQuestion: Ounces of alligator tail meat per Gator Bites order.
mappings.notes: Breading/batter not included — add a second component if wanted. 6 oz = $4.68. 218 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 0.5 lb ASSUMED, back-solved from ACE's explicit $3.00 at the old $5.99/lb. MarginEdge brackets a single fillet at 5-9 oz (the kitchen accepted a '6/8' fillet as a like-for-like substitute on 2026-08-23; historical SKUs are '5/7OZ' and '7-9Oz') but does not say fillets per order.
mappings.residualQuestion: One whole fillet per order (then a 6-8 oz fillet is the spec) or a fixed cut weight?
mappings.notes: $6.24/lb latest (Samuels wild Chesapeake $5.99 -> $6.24 on 08-15; J.J. McDonnell $6.10; one 10 lb farmed substitute at $8.99). One 7 oz fillet = $2.73. Shares the product with Blue Catfish Tacos. 99 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 2 crabs (from the Toast name). BLOCKED: the product is priced per Case ($190 latest) and no purchased SKU carries a count. August purchases coded to this product: Samuels '1s Full Box' $225 (9 boxes, #1 grade), Stanley Pearlman 'Steamed Crab Bu' $299 -> $190 (8 bushels, ungraded), Samuels 'Cooked Fresh Males Full Bushel' $125 (2), '#1 Males Maryland' $175 (1). None is labelled #2 despite the product name. Samuels' own spec: #1 bushel box = 6-7 dozen, #2 = 8-10 dozen.
mappings.residualQuestion: Which case feeds the AYCE crab line (Samuels 1s Full Box or Pearlman bushel), and how many crabs were in the last one received? Then set unitsPerReportByUnit to that count.
mappings.notes: Deliberately left unpriceable rather than guessing. Envelope: $5.36-$6.25 per 2 crabs from the $225 #1 box (72-84 crabs), $4.52-$5.28 from the $190 bushel as #1s, $2.08-$3.47 from the $125 bushel. Unit prices ranged $125-$299 in one month and latestPrice is 14% below the month's weighted $220. 450 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 2 chops ASSUMED (the example row in docs/CHEF_COSTS.md says '2 chops' but was never chef-confirmed) x one chop = 2.375 oz DERIVED from MarginEdge: August racks are Fells Point 'Lamb N.Z Rack 18/20 Frenched' (18-20 oz per rack, 414 lb) and, since 2026-08-28, '16/18' (118 lb); at 8 ribs per rack 19/8 = 2.375 oz per bone-in chop = 6.74 chops per lb (16/18 grade: 2.125 oz = 7.53 per lb). NZ frenched racks are sold as 7-9 ribs, so per-chop weight carries about +/-12%.
mappings.residualQuestion: How many single-rib chops are plated on one Lamb Chops unit (AYCE round, and is the $19 starter the same plate)? Is every rib of the rack plated?
mappings.notes: Per chop $2.75 at $18.51/lb (99.6% of August pounds; the $18.76 latestPrice comes from one 2 lb line on 08-31). 2 chops = $5.50, 3 = $8.25. ACE's $4.00 is 25% under even at 2 chops. Purchases vs cached Toast sales (~115 chops bought/day vs ~33 Lamb Chops units/day) point to 3-4 chops per unit unless lamb rack is also used by Nue, which shares MarginEdge unit 377809302 — so the count is genuinely open. 952 AYCE units observed (2nd highest volume).

mappings.portionBasis: 1 leg. Weight DERIVED from the purchased grade: 94% of August pounds are J.J. McDonnell 'King Crab Legs 16/20 Gold' (620 lb @ $53.95/lb); 16/20 = 16-20 legs per 10 lb -> 0.556 lb (8.9 oz) per leg if the case is legs only = 1.8 legs per lb. If the case is legs AND claws (industry default, ~3:1) a leg is ~0.46 lb (~$25) and a claw served as a 'leg' ~0.42 lb (~$22.50).
mappings.residualQuestion: Open one 20 lb J.J. McDonnell 16/20 case and count legs and claws separately; is a claw ever served as an AYCE 'leg'?
mappings.notes: $29.97 at legs-only (matches ACE's existing $30); defensible range $22.50-$33.72. DATA QUALITY: the same MarginEdge product also carries Restaurant Depot 'King Crab Red 20Up 20 Lbs' at $625-630 per 20 lb case = $31.4/lb (2 cases in Aug). If an RD invoice processes last, latestPrice flips to $31.4 and this row's cost would fall ~42% (the sync's -40% guard holds it). Fix on the MarginEdge side: split the product by grade/species. 650 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 0.2675 lb (4.3 oz raw) ASSUMED, back-solved from ACE's rough $5.94 at $22.20/lb. Zabuton = Denver steak = chuck flap, and the McLean vendor items are literally 'Imperial American Wagyu ... Chuck Flap', so the product match is firm; the portion and trim yield are not in MarginEdge.
mappings.residualQuestion: Raw-weight portion (oz) the zabuton is cut to, and trim yield.
mappings.notes: $22.20/lb latest (Aug $21.90-23.49 across Diamond/Sapphire Irodori tiers; 432 lb). 4 oz = $5.55, 5 oz = $6.94, 6 oz = $8.33 raw. 569 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 8 oz as named = 0.5 lb raw boneless (112A lip-on rolls: Fells Point Creekstone $18.04-18.54, Demkota Prime $18.61-19.76, US Foods $15.75-18.08; 620 lb in Aug). Bone-in is not a feasible source for an 8 oz steak (that product is 24 oz bone-in steaks). Steaks are cut in-house from whole rolls, so a trim/end-piece yield applies on top of 100%.
mappings.residualQuestion: Cost at 100% yield ($9.27) or apply a cutting yield (85% -> $10.91)? Are trim and end pieces credited to another item?
mappings.notes: $9.27 floor at latest $18.54/lb vs ACE rough $10.00. Product blends Prime and Choice under one id (Aug weighted ~$18.30/lb). 380 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 6 oysters as named x $1.35 each. The product NAMED 'Fanny Bay' (#942139937) is a near-orphan (1 line in Aug); 100% of the August Fanny Bay volume (3,060 pcs 'Oyster Fanny Bay Baynes Sound B.C' @ $1.35, plus Stanley Pearlman 120-ct cases @ $130 = $1.08 each) is coded to #833486701, which is the de facto West Coast half-shell product despite its 'Shigoku' name.
mappings.residualQuestion: none for the count; MarginEdge-side: rename/merge #833486701 so the product name says what it holds.
mappings.notes: $8.10 at $1.35 (Aug weighted $1.28 -> $7.68) vs ACE rough $10.80, which equals $1.35 / 0.75 — an implied 25% shrink no invoice supports. 165 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 12 oysters as named. Same product note as the (6) row.
mappings.residualQuestion: none
mappings.notes: $16.20 at $1.35 vs ACE rough $21.60. 146 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 6 oysters as named. Product is priced per Case/Box ($72.95-75.95, 154 J.J. McDonnell boxes in Aug) and the MarginEdge packaging record carries no count; 100 per box is the grower's spec (True Chesapeake Oyster Co.) and the count on every sibling East Coast vendor item that does have packaging (Sewanscott, Blackberry, Watch House: 100 EA). ACE's own $4.68 / 6 = $0.78 = $78 per 100-ct box.

mappings.notes: $4.38 at $72.95/100 vs ACE $4.68 (stale $78 box). 155 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 12 oysters as named. Same 100-per-box basis as the (6) row.
mappings.residualQuestion: Same as the (6) row.
mappings.notes: $8.75 at $72.95/100 vs ACE $9.36. 246 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: 1.192 lb ASSUMED, back-solved from ACE's rough $5.95 at $4.99/lb. Bought as NZ green-shell cooked half-shell, frozen IQF, 24 lb cases (912 lb in Aug, all Samuels, all $4.99/lb) and plated by the piece; MarginEdge does not record the size grade (9-19 pieces per lb by grade), so neither count nor weight per order is derivable.
mappings.residualQuestion: How many half-shell mussels per order, and which size grade is being shipped?
mappings.notes: $0.26-$0.55 per half-shell; 12 pieces = $3.10-$6.60. 438 units observed.

mappings.portionBasis: One 4 oz scoop ASSUMED = 1/32 gal. Product priced per gallon ($12.72 latest; US Foods 3 gal tubs at $41.23-41.99 = $13.74-14.00/gal, PFG $25.49-30.15 per tub).
mappings.residualQuestion: Scoop size (oz) per Vanilla Ice Cream order.
mappings.notes: 4 oz scoop = $0.40 vs the flat $2.00 menu fallback ACE uses today. Low dollars, but 448 units on the fallback tier. PFG packaging 8978541 records a 3 gal tub as quantity 1 gallon — a MarginEdge packaging error that inflates that vendor's $/gal.
